support_rule: Correct joint supervision must have beneficial 95% paired target-cluster EER and AUC differences against both controls and no worse mean HTER. Report partial results separately.
uncertainty_unit: ten users; average three seeds per target before resampling; shared background makes intervals exploratory
hyperparameter_policy: same two lambdas for correct/wrong; each candidate400steps; shared lambda selected from pooled correct/wrong development identity AUC thenEER; target identity/test words excluded
query_policy: all fixed test windows counted; no Audio, hard activity mask, window or user selection
historical_exposure: same eight test words were evaluated in the preceding experiment; this is an exploratory replication, not independent blind confirmation
